diaspora_bullets: A representation milestone for Muslim Americans and the wider immigrant diaspora
Muslims have served in the House, but never before in the Senate
news_summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's open US Senate seat, defeating Republican Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim elected to the Senate.
payoff: His win held a must-win seat as Democrats retook both chambers of Congress.
